fix_subject: Reuse the buffer destruction policy for replaced handles and tighten the regression tests

labels.summary: A replaced metadata block handle could reload its disk block after eviction while a checkpoint was rewriting that block in place, producing intermittent 'Corrupt database' errors; the fix sets the old handle to destroy on eviction and makes it return an invalid pin so MetadataManager::Pin re-resolves the current handle.
